name: Leil Como 3-180 3-Person Indoor Sauna
description: Leil Como 3-180 3-Person Indoor Sauna Features Premium 40mm ThermoWood® Construction : Thermally modified Scandinavian pine walls deliver exceptional insulation, moisture resistance, and dimensional stability, ensuring decades of reliable use without warping, rotting, or resin leakage even with frequent sauna sessions. Spacious 3-Person Design with Extended Seating : Generous 1.8-meter width and 1.3-meter depth provides ample room for three adults to sit comfortably side-by-side or recline partially, with 4.0 cubic meter interior volume offering uncompromising space and relaxation. Single-Level Extended Bench Configuration : Generous single-level Aspen bench with integrated backrest spans the sauna's interior, providing comfortable seating for three people with excellent back support and ample leg room for extended wellness sessions. Tempered Glass Front Door : Premium 8mm clear tempered glass door with black hardware and premium handle creates an open, contemporary aesthetic while maintaining excellent heat retention and durability for long-term daily use. Two-Piece Insulated Ceiling : 15mm thermally modified ThermoWood® ceiling panels separated into two elements enhance heat retention, improve heat distribution, and simplify installation while maintaining structural integrity. Vertical Bar Front Wall Design : Clean minimalist architecture with vertical bar facade creates sophisticated Scandinavian aesthetic while providing structural support and allowing unobstructed views into your wellness space. Engineered Soft Heat Airflow System : Adjustable ceiling vent and elevated base airflow design create balanced humidity-to-temperature ratio, preventing dry stinging heat sensation and enabling longer, deeper therapeutic sessions. Adjustable Feet & Leveling System : M8x40 adjustable legs with rubber pads allow precise leveling on any indoor surface type, ensuring proper structural alignment and stable operation on uneven floors or carpeting. Optional LED Lighting & Hexagon DECO Panels : Customizable ambient lighting system and decorative hexagon mosaic back wall panels transform your sauna into an elegant wellness sanctuary with spa-quality ambiance and personalized design. Modular Pre-Fabricated Assembly Kit : Pre-fabricated wall logs and ceiling elements with modular design allow three-four people to complete assembly in 6-8 hours using basic tools, with detailed instructions and all fasteners included. Nordic Heritage Engineering : Handcrafted in Estonia with 16+ years of sauna expertise, combining contemporary Nordic design with traditional sauna culture and rigorous testing for authentic, reliable performance. Saunum Air-Blending Compatible : Engineered to work seamlessly with Saunum heater systems that mix hot ceiling air with cooler floor air, eliminating "cold feet" and creating balanced, breathable warmth for three people. Leil Como 3-180 Specifications Product Name Leil Como 3-180 3-Person Indoor Sauna Kit Model Number Como 3-180 Capacity 3 persons Exterior Width 1,810mm (71.3 inches / 5.9 feet) Exterior Depth 1,600mm (63.0 inches / 5.2 feet) Exterior Height 2,200mm (86.6 inches / 7.2 feet) Interior Width 1,700mm (66.9 inches) Interior Depth 1,310mm (51.6 inches) Interior Height 2,080mm (81.9 inches) Interior Volume Approximately 4.0 cubic meters (141.3 cubic feet) Floor Area Footprint 2.3 square meters (24.8 square feet) Wall Thickness 40mm (1.57 inches) ThermoWood® Ceiling Thickness 15mm STS ThermoWood® with two-piece insulated panels Door Type Clear tempered 8mm glass with black hardware and premium handle Bench Configuration Single-level extended Aspen bench with integrated backrest spanning full interior width Estimated Assembly Weight 700-800 kg (1,540-1,760 lbs) assembled Shipping/Crate Weight Varies with packaging, shipped LTL freight Assembly Time 6-8 hours with 3-4 people (3-4 persons recommended for optimal efficiency) Warranty 2-year manufacturer's warranty covering materials, manufacturing defects, and pre-transport damage Material Standards Nordic Lunawood ThermoWood® (thermally modified pine), tempered glass, stainless steel hardware, Aspen benches Ventilation System Adjustable ceiling vent (100mm), elevated base airflow with dual-opening design Heater Compatibility Optional electric heaters 6-9kW recommended (HUUM Drop 6, Saunum, Harvia models; sold separately) Electrical Requirements 220-240V hardwired connection with dedicated breaker (heater-dependent amperage; 120V recommended for LED lighting) Floor Installation Requirements Stable, level surface with concrete foundation or driven piles; 600mm x 600mm minimum clearance around sauna required Design Awards Red Dot: Best of the Best 2024 international design recognition Customization Options Standard or Hexagon DECO decorative back wall panel, LED lighting packages (bench and backrest options), various heater packages Assembly Kit Includes Pre-fabricated wall logs, two ceiling elements, tempered glass door, single extended bench with backrest, ventilation valve, adjustable legs with rubber pads, all fasteners and hardware, electrical cable conduit, installation manual Leil Como 3-180 Frequently Asked Questions Can three adults fit comfortably in the Como 3-180, and what is the seating arrangement? Yes, the Como 3-180 is specifically engineered for comfortable 3-person use. The 1.7-meter interior width and single-level extended Aspen bench with integrated backrest allow three adults to sit comfortably side-by-side with ample shoulder room. The design also allows flexibility for one or two people to recline partially on the spacious bench, making it ideal for families, couples with a guest, or small group wellness sessions. The 2,080mm interior height accommodates seated and slightly reclined positions for extended sessions. What size room or space is required for the Como 3-180? The Como 3-180 exterior dimensions are 1,810mm wide x 1,600mm deep x 2,200mm tall. For proper installation and access, plan for a room at least 2,100mm x 1,900mm (6'10" x 6'2") minimum, with 600mm clearance space on all sides recommended for ventilation, airflow, and maintenance. The sauna can be placed in a corner by assembling the wall logs first, then positioning against the walls, but ensure adequate ventilation around the roof area. A ceiling height of at least 2,400mm is recommended to accommodate the 2,200mm sauna plus airflow above. What heater capacity should I choose for the Como 3-180, and are heaters included? Heaters are sold separately and not included with the sauna kit. For the Como 3-180's 4.0 cubic meter interior volume, we recommend electric heaters in the 6-9kW capacity range. Leil particularly recommends HUUM Drop 6 (6-7kW) which features patented air-blending technology that mixes hot ceiling air with cooler floor air, creating balanced warmth and eliminating "cold feet." Alternative options include higher-capacity Saunum or Harvia brands. Consult manufacturer heater sizing recommendations or contact sales to match your specific heat output needs and desired warm-up time for three people. How difficult is assembly, and do I need professional installation? The Como 3-180 uses pre-fabricated modular wall logs that are easier to assemble than traditional barrel staves. Three to four capable people can complete assembly in 6-8 hours following the detailed installation manual included with your kit. A third to fourth person is recommended for handling and installing the heavy tempered glass door safely and for managing the larger wall panels. No professional installation is required if you have basic tools (hammer, screwdriver, drill) and follow instructions. However, electrical wiring must be completed by a certified electrician to ensure safety and local code compliance. What is ThermoWood® and why is it better than regular cedar for saunas? ThermoWood® is Scandinavian pine that is heat-treated using only heat and steam (no chemicals) to remove internal moisture and resins. This thermal modification creates wood that is naturally resistant to warping, shrinking, rotting, and insect damage—far superior to untreated cedar, hemlock, or softwoods. ThermoWood® won't leak sticky resin even in extreme heat, maintains dimensional stability for decades without twisting, and develops a beautiful natural patina over time. The Como 3-180's 40mm thick ThermoWood® walls provide exceptional insulation, heat retention, and durability compared to standard sauna materials. Can I customize the Como 3-180 with lighting or decorative back wall panels? Yes, the Como 3-180 offers excellent customization options. You can add optional LED lighting systems in multiple configurations that provide warm ambient illumination. The standard back wall can be upgraded to a beautiful Hexagon DECO decorative panel that adds visual elegance and spa-quality aesthetics to complement your interior design. These options can be selected during purchase or added as upgrades, allowing you to personalize your wellness space to match your décor preferences and create the perfect relaxation atmosphere for three people. Does the Como 3-180 include a warranty, and what does it cover? The Como 3-180 includes a comprehensive 2-year manufacturer's warranty covering defects in materials, manufacturing quality, and any damage occurring before transportation delivery. The warranty does not cover natural wood variations (such as color changes, knots, or small cracks), normal wear and tear from regular use, incorrect assembly or installation, force majeure events (natural disasters, wars), or unauthorized modifications. Claims must be filed within the warranty period by contacting the manufacturer with photographic documentation of the defect. Warranty coverage differs for commercial use models. What are the electrical and site preparation requirements for the Como 3-180? The Como 3-180 requires a stable, level floor prepared with a concrete foundation or driven piles to ensure structural integrity and prevent settling over time. The sauna requires a 220-240V hardwired connection with a dedicated breaker for the electric heater (specific amperage depends on your chosen heater model, typically 30-50 amps for 6-9kW heaters). A dedicated 120V connection is also recommended for LED lighting and control systems if you order those options. We strongly recommend confirming exact electrical specifications with a qualified electrician based on your heater selection before installation to ensure full compliance with local electrical codes and safety standards. How long will the Como 3-180 last, and what maintenance does it require? With proper care, the Como 3-180 can provide 20+ years of reliable performance thanks to its ThermoWood® construction and premium materials. Annual maintenance is recommended: apply UV-protective exterior varnish to maintain color and protect against moisture/weathering, and treat wooden benches with specialized sauna bench oils for smooth, long-lasting comfort. The tempered glass door and stainless hardware require only routine cleaning with mild soap and water. Ensure proper ventilation during use to manage humidity. Regular maintenance preserves the sauna's structural integrity, appearance, and function throughout its lifetime. What is included in delivery, and how is the Como 3-180 shipped? The Como 3-180 is shipped fully crated via LTL (less-than-truckload) freight for curbside delivery to most US locations. The delivery includes the complete pre-fabricated sauna kit with all wall logs, two ceiling elements, tempered glass door, single extended bench with integrated backrest, ventilation valve, adjustable legs with rubber pads, all fasteners and hardware, electrical cable conduit, and comprehensive assembly instructions. Upon delivery, the driver will unload the crate at curb-side—you'll need at least three people to unpack and move the larger components (approximately 60-90 minutes). Optional heaters and accessories typically ship separately. Inspect the crate for visible damage before signing delivery paperwork, and report any concealed damage within 5 business days.
